severity_source_fallback.SD-02: no detecting-seat per-finding tag; Editorial Decision Letter roadmap R5 severity 'Major' used per the README severity-source ladder

notes: Blinded isolated run per README protocol (same dispatch and severity mapping rule as the ms01_quant r1 record). Panel decision: Major Revision (F1+F2; 4 DA CRITICAL rows). Strict recall 9/9; critical-band recall 2/2. All nine seeded defects named substantively, most by multiple seats from independent angles. The panel's DA additionally raised a minor observation that survey subgroups 9+11=20 leave 28 of N=48 unaccounted in the contrast; adjudication note: this is NOT an inconsistency — the design has three institutions and the manuscript never claims the two contrasted subgroups exhaust the survey sample, so the remaining 28 can be third-site respondents. Recorded only as a fixture-observation; it does not affect any count (false-finding counting applies to the clean control only). Severity-agreement losses: DA rated the Delacroix reversal (expected minor; the fixture seeds it as self-contained against the paper's own reference annotation) and the abstract-count contradiction (expected major) as CRITICAL, and rated sector-generalization (expected critical) only MAJOR — direction of the mismatch is not uniformly harsher, it is unanchored (#574 A3 evidence).
